query: Official Flux LoRA training workflow crashes with NameError/undefined 'Version' when FluxTrainLoop checks the torch version. Multiple users reproduce on ComfyUI 0.3.13 / torch 2.5.1.

desired.outcome: 3dluvr diagnosed the bug inside comfyui-fluxtrainer: 'Version' is undefined and comparing versions as strings is meaningless; the check should be plain torch.__version__ >= "2.4.0". ltdrdata (member) redirected the issue to kijai/ComfyUI-FluxTrainer. Proposed-only (never merged in this repo).
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies the correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.
